title: A CMOS Passive Mixer With Low Flicker Noise for Low-Power Direct-Conversion Receiver
figure_number: Fig. 2. (a) Simpliﬁed schematic of a typical single-balanced active mixer. (b) Simpliﬁed schematic of a single-balanced passive mixer.
function_summary: CMOS Passive Mixer: CMOS switches with a unique bias-shifting network to track the LO DC offset are devised to reduce the second-order intermodulation.
